proposedNewPolicy.boundedAuthority: One source-bound scalar successor policy; no new generation, RGB edit, unrelated terrain engine or tool-family expansion.
proposedNewPolicy.necessaryNewMath: Evaluate a small reviewed set of affine semantic facet planes from source feature geometry; compose coarse field BEFORE wrapped smoothing, with no final hard class selector.
proposedNewPolicy.coarseField: A(x,y)=reviewed plane rise on non-overlapping source facet regions,0on surrounding snow. H_semantic=H_snow+gblur(A,sigma_contact). Plane regions/controls are manual semantic authoring, not colour/luminance fits.
proposedNewPolicy.continuity: Final semantic field is a wrapped Gaussian convolution; it has no np.where-selected nonzero jump. Adjacent face controls must share consistent edge heights where the source is continuous. Deliberate fracture creases need explicit source controls.
proposedNewPolicy.embedding: Proposed contact sigma4master pixels for initial pilot, based on visible snow-lap scale, not a larger old bevel. It filters the composed field and does not impose an image-perimeter fade. Actual contact profile must be reviewed.
proposedNewPolicy.facetShape: Three non-collinear reviewed source feature controls define each affine face. This is an artistic relative height/normal hypothesis, not measured3D. Pilot source polygons/partition are not yet approved or complete.
proposedNewPolicy.macroAmplitude: Keep snow baseline .55 and proposed rock interior rises roughly .16-.24, comparable to failed trial rock/snow span. Fixed .3/.5 normals and original neutral lights. Do not reduce rise/normal amplitude to hide bad shape.
proposedNewPolicy.microDetail: Recompute existing craft float64 and prove its float32 replay equals initial NPY. Keep gain .1 (same as failed .05micro policy). Preserve existing snow detail B-.5; use fine-only rock residual B-gblur(B,8master pixels). Blend these with a softly wrapped reviewed MATERIAL-role weight, not elevation membership, so pale caps/veins do not choose the lower plane. No per-pore amplitude fit or normalization.
proposedNewPolicy.microLimit: Removing broad rock tonal contrast is intentional separation from shading/staining, but may omit real broad rock roughness. Semantic facet controls must supply visible broad faces; actual RMS/PSD and source crop comparison must show useful photographic fine detail without new noise.
proposedNewPolicy.noClipping: Finite scalar in0..1 must hold with declared headroom; reject clipping/normal amplitude tricks. One finalfloat32 cast.
proposedNewPolicy.RGBContract: Canonical RGB PNG bytes must equal verified initial color.png. Raw/native/prompt/generationCount remain unchanged.
